paras: Upgrade your Ford Focus RS Mk3 's front braking performance with DIXCEL brake rotors, engineered in Japan and developed through decades of OEM supply and motorsport experience. DIXCEL rotors are designed to deliver consistent braking performance, stable pedal feel, and reliable control for daily driving through to circuit and trackday use.

This listing covers the DIXCEL brake rotor types shown for the Ford Focus RS Mk3 (DYB) 2015-2018, the all-wheel-drive performance flagship developed by Ford Performance with the 2.3L EcoBoost engine producing 257kW. All rotors for this application are 350x25mm vented and fit the factory Brembo 4-piston front caliper setup. Multiple rotor types are available, ranging from street-focused replacements to higher-performance applications. Use the comparison chart on this product page to select the rotor type best suited to your driving style and vehicle configuration.
